prompt: The user names gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills at commit 7eb1b53305fab881f4758e2eff2e371cd7869221 and asks for its pinned offline inventory and selective guide installation.
expected_behavior: Use the exact project operator, preserve the pinned version and game/client ownership, and explain that guide installation does not install upstream skills, engines, plugins, assets, providers, or runtimes.

prompt: Select only the Godot and Defold guidance from the pinned collection for an offline review; do not install engines or execute upstream code.
expected_behavior: Use the collection router for the requested Godot and Defold source choices, keep the operation offline and selective, and require separate approval before any engine, provider, plugin, asset, or upstream-runtime action.

prompt: A user asks for a generic local web game implementation and separately asks to curate a third-party Unity skill pack; the gamedev-skills collection is not named.
expected_behavior: Route the local web-game implementation to web-game-development and the generic Unity pack curation to unity-gamedev-skill-pack; do not force the awesome gamedev collection for either near-miss.

prompt: The user names gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills and asks to install its guide where an existing skill name collides, while also requesting generic engine routing advice.
expected_behavior: Inspect the collision-aware selection path, preserve existing same-root and unrelated skills, and keep generic routing advice separate from installing or replacing the collection operator.

prompt: Install the pinned collection guide while an existing project has current skills and a different same-root skill with the same retired-looking name.
expected_behavior: Preserve current and foreign same-root data, remove only the fingerprinted retired copy when the installer identifies it, keep unrelated HOME/project data untouched, and retain the declared collection version rather than silently upgrading it.

prompt: The user asks to install the whole upstream pack, a native plugin, and the engines, then asks whether the setup is ready after the offline helper reports selected-file metadata.
expected_behavior: Stop for explicit approval before whole-pack installation, native-plugin or engine changes, provider use, and upstream execution; report runtime_verified=false and do not claim readiness from metadata, source hashes, or guide presence alone.
